articles.title: Local Lenders Set to Supercharge Crypto Trading in Germany
articles.summary: The cryptocurrency market in Germany is expected to gain significant momentum in the coming months as millions of people will soon be able to trade virtual currencies directly through their local banks, without having to go through specialized third-party platforms.
